decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to quickly apply pressure and overwhelm the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison, it aims to control the battlefield and deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes various ways to generate tokens and maximize board presence, such as Ocelot Pride and Seasoned Pyromancer. Additionally, it provides disruption with cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Thraben Charm, while also ensuring mana consistency with a mix of lands and ramp spells.

The deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's game plan by using a combination of low-cost creatures and removal spells. It utilizes efficient creatures like Flickerwisp and Recruiter of the Guard to control the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Aven Interrupter and Overlord of the Balemurk. Aether Vial allows for fast creature deployment, while Ephemerate provides additional value by blinking creatures with powerful enters-the-battlefield effects. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up its own board presence to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast creature plays and burn spells. It uses cards like Guide of Souls, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure early on, while Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional threats. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Chained to the Rocks to take out opposing creatures and control the board. With a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells, this deck looks to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion and card advantage to set up a combo win condition utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station. Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and help with setting up the combo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps find key pieces while Lavinia, Azorius Renegade disrupts the opponent's mana base. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Portable Hole and Soul-Guide Lantern to control the opponent's board state. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game quickly through mill or damage.

The deck focuses on assembling the necessary pieces to create powerful combos and generate big mana. Cards like Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor are crucial to ramping up fast and efficiently. Utilizing land tutors like Expedition Map and Tolaria West, along with strong lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, the deck aims for explosive plays and game-winning sequences. By utilizing various land synergies and combo pieces, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents and establish a dominant board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows you to continually loop cards from your graveyard and your library to eventually win the game. Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and other cards help you dig through your deck and set up the combo. Other cards like Malevolent Rumble provide additional support and disruption to control the game. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces and outvalue your opponent to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on generating value through the Cascade mechanic, using cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea to cheat out high-cost spells like Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco. With Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to support the archetype, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive playstyle. It also includes interaction with cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to control the board. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the multicolored spells in the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around casting powerful spells for free and maximizing efficiency.

This deck focuses on utilizing a landless combo strategy to quickly generate mana and disrupt opponent's plays. It combines cards like Thundertrap Trainer, Hydroelectric Specimen, and Tameshi, Reality Architect to ramp up mana production, while using Lotus Bloom and Goblin Charbelcher for win conditions. Control elements like Force of Negation, Disrupting Shoal, and Spell Snare help protect the combo pieces, while cards like Jwari Disruption, Sink into Stupor, and Suppression Ray disrupt opponent's game plan. Whir of Invention and Sea Gate Restoration provide additional utility and card advantage to keep the deck running smoothly.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to cast threats like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Urza's Saga to generate even more mana and accelerate its game plan. The goal is to assemble a powerful board state and quickly close out the game through a combination of landfall triggers and powerful creature attacks. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly ramp up and execute its game plan, putting the opponent on the back foot from the start.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells, utilizing a mix of Boros-colored cards to maximize efficiency. By combining efficient creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and seasoned Pyromancer with removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the board. Cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison provide additional utility and disruption, allowing the deck to adapt to different matchups and strategies. The inclusion of strong mana fixing and land options ensures consistency and flexibility in its gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and utilizing various spells to deal damage and control the board. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury are key threats, supported by cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built around Boros colors with a mix of fetch lands and utility lands like Arena of Glory. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes strong flying creatures like Witch Enchanter and Guide of Souls, along with versatile spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for removal and direct damage. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional support and card advantage. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to disrupt opponents' strategies. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of Plains, Mountains, and fetch lands.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to create explosive combos with Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble, allowing for quick and powerful wins. It also includes various pieces of control and disruption elements to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch offer card advantage and help dig for combo pieces, while Mox Amber and Mox Opal provide fast mana acceleration. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enter-the-battlefield abilities to apply pressure on the opponent while also gaining value through blinking them with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp. Aether Vial is used to cheat creatures into play at instant speed, while Fatal Push provides removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive abilities, forcing them to constantly react to the board state. By repeatedly blinking key creatures, the deck can generate incremental advantages and control the tempo of the game.

The deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to quickly accelerate Eldrazi threats onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells and disruptive artifacts. It aims to control the game early on with cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return, then quickly ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to overwhelm the opponent. The deck's mana base is focused on providing the necessary colorless mana sources to ramp into its Eldrazi threats efficiently.

The main concept of this Mardu Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Support cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah help to generate additional value and keep the pressure on. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing the aggressive creatures to push through for victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to boost the attacking power of the creatures on the battlefield. With a mix of creature aggression and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The focus of this Boros Aggro deck is on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to use Underworld Breach in conjunction with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill the opponent's library and win the game. It utilizes various artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage, while also including interaction like Unholy Heat and Engineered Explosives to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The powerful synergies between these cards allow the deck to efficiently execute its game plan and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to recur cards from the graveyard, particularly artifacts like Mox Opal and Grinding Station, in order to generate a powerful combo that can deal massive amounts of damage quickly. It also includes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to help dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent with cards like Unholy Heat and Spell Snare while setting up its combo. The land base includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City to further assist in the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard, enabling powerful combos with cards like Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. The goal is to quickly assemble a game-winning board state by looping spells with the help of powerful artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thassa's Oracle offer additional card advantage and win conditions. This deck is designed to quickly overwhelm opponents with its graveyard synergy and efficient combo pieces, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on maintaining control over the opponent through a combination of countering spells, destroying threats, and disrupting their resources. By using a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and hand disruption, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while deploying its own threats, such as Murktide Regent and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Unearth and Thought Scour to further outvalue the opponent. Through efficient removal and disruption, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory.

The deck focuses on using various creatures and spells to disrupt and control the opponent's board while dealing damage quickly. It utilizes cards like Fatal Push and Solitude for removal, Aether Vial for mana acceleration, and Ephemerate for extra value. It also includes creatures with powerful abilities like Skyclave Apparition and Recruiter of the Guard to control the board and create advantage. The key strategy is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively while utilizing the "blink" mechanic to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can continuously flicker creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Solitude to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Recruiter of the Guard helps search for key creatures, while Aether Vial allows for instant-speed creature deployment. With a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and consistent value generation through blinking creatures.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's plans with a variety of counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage through card draw and graveyard recursion. The deck aims to control the game by countering key spells, removing threats, and eventually winning through its powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in a slower, more controlling game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, and removal spells. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Spell Snare, and Force of Negation, the deck aims to limit the opponent's options and prevent them from developing their board. Additionally, cards like Thought Scour and Consider help the player dig for key cards while cards like Unearth and Fatal Push provide efficient removal options. The deck also includes a win condition in the form of Murktide Regent and Graveyard Trespasser to close out the game.

This deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using Talismans and Utopia Sprawl, while controlling the board with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return. The win condition is to summon powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, which can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while Nulldrifter and Devourer of Destiny offer card advantage. The deck also includes Sowing Mycospawn for token generation and a variety of land options to ensure consistent mana production.

This deck focuses on rapidly ramping up mana to play powerful Eldrazi creatures ahead of schedule, while utilizing control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Through the Breach and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine allow for fast deployment of Eldrazi threats, backed up by counterspells like Kozilek's Command and card draw with Nulldrifter. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures like Ulamog, the Defiler and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, while maintaining control of the game through disruptive spells and efficient mana sources.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing Hydroelectric Specimen and Tameshi, Reality Architect to generate massive amounts of mana, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Goblin Charbelcher. It also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Suppression Ray to protect the combo pieces. The deck utilizes Whir of Invention to tutor for key cards and has access to card draw and filtering with Preordain and Waterlogged Teachings. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful win condition.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana through rituals and mana producers like Ruby Medallion, in order to cast a high number of spells in a single turn. This allows the player to utilize cards like Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard and generate additional value. Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible provide card draw and digging for combo pieces, while Wish can tutor for specific cards needed for the win condition. The deck aims to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be searched for and deployed to create powerful interactions and combos. It utilizes toolbox cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to find specific creatures needed for the situation. The deck also includes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and control the board. Overall, the deck aims to create a flexible and dynamic game plan through the use of versatile creatures and combo potential.
